name: GenieSeo
description:
GenieSeo connects Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 to Claude — turning your Claude into a full-time SEO analyst, keyword research tool, rank tracker, and technical SEO auditor. No dashboard logins, no CSV exports, no pivot tables.

Searching for an SEO MCP, a Google Search Console MCP, a GA4 MCP, a keyword research MCP, or a rank tracking MCP? This one server does all of it. Ask in plain English; answers come live from Google's official Search Console and Analytics Data APIs.

- Keyword research & rank tracking — queries, impressions, clicks, CTR, and exact average Google position by date range, country, device, or page. Find striking-distance keywords stuck on page 2.
- Traffic drop & algorithm update audits — compare any two periods to pinpoint which pages and keywords lost rankings after a Google core update.
- Page-level keyword audits — every query driving clicks to a single URL, for content refreshes and on-page SEO.
- Google indexing & technical SEO — live URL inspection for index status, crawl status, canonical selection, and mobile usability. One URL or hundreds.
- XML sitemap monitoring — submitted versus indexed counts, processing errors, one-command resubmission.
- GA4 analytics — real-time active users, acquisition channels, landing pages, and conversion funnels beside your search data.

Built for founders, content marketers, e-commerce owners, agencies, and SEO specialists who want real Google search data — and the recommendation that follows from it — instantly, inside Claude.

Claude combines multiple analyses in a single conversation, cross referencing Search Console and Google Analytics, asking clarifying questions, and turning raw SEO and analytics data into clear, actionable recommendations.

Keywords: SEO MCP, Google Search Console MCP, GSC MCP, GA4 MCP, keyword research MCP, rank tracking MCP, technical SEO MCP.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GenieSeo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GenieSeo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://seo.geniedial.in/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GenieSeo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GenieSeo lists 29 MCP tools, including add_site, batch_url_inspection, check_indexing_issues, compare_search_periods, delete_site, delete_sitemap, get_advanced_search_analytics, get_capabilities, get_creator_info, get_ga4_custom_dimensions_and_metrics, get_ga4_property_details, and get_performance_overview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GenieSeo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GenieSeo in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
GenieSeo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GenieSeo is developed by GenieSeo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
